title: A template whose accent appears in many rules still gets the brand accent: the module fits the limit
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: Rules join into selector lists only where the cascade allows; selectors a browser may not know keep their own rule.
A module over the limit drops the last family shades' markup forms and keeps the accent; routes alone over the limit are refused.

tests: rules with one declaration under the same at-rules join into one selector list, only where the cascade allows
a module over the limit drops the markup forms of the last family colours and keeps the brand accent
a module whose stylesheet routes alone pass the limit is refused, never cut
a page's own markup is reached: SVG paint attributes and inline styles, in any letter case
